messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary failure pattern detected for service `inference-runtime` (canary group c3) in us-west-2. 5/10 pods reporting image pull errors and 3/10 returning 502s.
Priya K: saw that — I started the rollout at ~1759001000, canaries passed smoke locally but cloud canary is failing. pausing rollout.
Alex M: copying — on it. what error are the pods showing?
Jamal: logs look like `pull access denied` and also `manifest unknown: manifest unknown` for the new tag. suspicious.
deploy-bot: sample events from canary: ```
Events:
  Warning Failed 30s kubelet, node-abc Failed to pull image "registry.redwood.ai/inference:2026-03-15-rc3"
  Warning Failed 28s kubelet, node-abc Error: image pull failed
  Warning Unhealthy 10s kubelet, node-abc Liveness probe failed: HTTP 502
```
Alex M: uh — retagging pipeline had a final step that retagged `latest` to the rc tag. I'm checking CI logs now.
Priya K: customer impact? any errors seen in prod traffic?
incident-bot: Metrics alert: 2.1% 5xx rate increase for /v1/generate in us-west-2 between 1759001100 and 1759001300. Approximately 0.6% of requests retried successfully via fallback region routing.
Jamal: confirmed increased 502s and latency spike. A small subset of users behind the canary gateway hit it.
Alex M: CI shows a registry race — the build job pushed two different images with same tag `2026-03-15-rc3`; registry accepted older manifest then later garbage-collected a layer, causing pull to fail on some nodes. There was a mutable-registry retag step.
Priya K: ok kill-switch? suggestion: disable rollout flag and roll back canary to previous image.
Alex M: proposing immediate steps: 1) flip feature flag to halt traffic to new canaries, 2) roll back canary deployment to stable image, 3) block CI tag to prevent re-push.
Jamal: +1. I can flip the flag and start rollback. Who owns the stable image sha?
release-eng: stable image is `registry.redwood.ai/inference:stable@sha256:9f4b2d...`.
Priya K: Jamal, go ahead to minimize impact. Use runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/canary-rollbacks
Jamal: executing now — running: `rctl feature disable inference_canary_traffic --env prod --group c3`
Jamal: (after) feature flag disabled :white_check_mark: traffic to new canaries stopped. Noting still some pods failing on image pull but no new traffic routed.
Alex M: starting rollback: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/inference inference=registry.redwood.ai/inference@sha256:9f4b2d...` applying to canary selectors c3.
deploy-bot: Deploy command accepted, rolling update initiated at 1759002100.
incident-bot: Noted rollback start. Will monitor health checks.
Priya K: while rollback continues, block the CI pipeline that created the mutable tag. Who can gate it?
Alex M: I disabled the retag job in CI (job id 9876) and added a temporary policy to reject pushes that overwrite existing digests.
Jamal: can confirm canary pods are coming up with stable image; health checks recovering. 502s decreasing.
incident-bot: Service health: 502 rate back to baseline ~1759002700. Latency normalizing.
SRE Lead: good quick rollback. Need to disable the mutable-tag workflow and schedule a forensics run. Also escalate to registry infra to check for partial GC.
Alex M: grabbing registry logs now. Found repeated `PUT /v2/inference/blobs/uploads/` from the retag job and two manifests with same tag but different digests. Possible race. Saving logs to: https://internal.redwood/logs/registry/1759001234-retag
Priya K: customer impact summary for pager: small fraction (~2% 5xx, ~0.6% failed hard) for ~20 minutes for us-west-2 only. No full outages. Any paying customers affected?
Jamal: one mid-market tenant reported elevated errors through support ticket #INC-8342, routed to SE for mitigation (they were hit but failover helped).
release-eng: we'll hold the full rollout until postmortem. Cancelled remaining batches.
Alex M: checklist for post-incident: 1) owner: Alex M, 2) timeline and CI job artifacts, 3) root cause: mutable-tag / retag race leading to inconsistent manifests, 4) mitigation: rollback + feature flag kill, CI guard rails, registry hardening, 5) follow-ups: postmortem write-up, update runbooks, fix CI job.
Priya K: assigning postmortem owner to Alex M — please loop in registry infra and release-eng. Target doc draft in 72h.
Alex M: will do. Also adding a small short-term guard: CI will require pushing immutable tags (sha-based) and PR approval to retag `latest`.
incident-bot: Incident closed: canary rollback successful, traffic restored to stable pool at 1759003300. Recommend postmortem.
Priya K: handoff to SRE Lead for monitoring and postmortem tracking. Thanks team. :slightly_smiling_face:
summary: Canary rollout failed due to CI retag (mutable registry) causing image pull/manifest errors; on-call disabled feature flag, rolled back canary, blocked CI job, and restored stable traffic. Impact: small increase in 5xx (~2%) in us-west-2 for ~20 minutes. Postmortem owner: Alex M
